newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey board okays $73 mln of local debt plans.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey board okays $73 mln of local debt plans.

text.p: New Jersey's Local Finance Board Wednesday approved $72.7 million of debt issues proposed by municipalities and local districts in the state.
The board approved bond issues totaling $33 million for 11 towns and cities, with the largest a $9.5 million school bond by Jersey City.
The board also approved $39.7 million of debt proposed by seven local fire districts and authorities. The largest was a $30 million project financing by the Hudson County Improvement Authority.
The figure also includes two lease purchase deals: $251,404 by Mount Laurel Township Fire District No 1, and $396,871 by Gloucester Township Fire District No 1.
